mud-creature.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production top-down 2D pixel RPG animation atlas.
Input image is an identity/style reference, not a sheet to copy literally. Create a NEW complete action sheet for the SAME small moss-covered brown mud creature in reference: squat compact clod body, moss tufts, branching antler-like twigs, two amber eyes, short chunky feet. Preserve its exact body design and proportions, earthy subdued palette, compact pixel shapes and strong dark contour.
Layout STRICTLY 10 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 40 clearly isolated sprites on real transparent background. Large 1600x1024 landscape composition, generous empty padding inside every cell, no touching cells, no grid lines/text/labels/shadows. Identical scale and stable feet/pivot in all cells. View is top-down three-quarter pixel RPG, same as reference.
ROWS in order: DOWN facing viewer, RIGHT profile, UP back facing away (no front eyes), LEFT profile.
COLUMNS each row: 1 attack-ready windup; 2 deeper attack anticipation; 3 forward attack strike (mud creature body shove/claw, insect mandible lunge); 4 recovering to ready. 5 flinch from hit; 6 settling after flinch. 7 death start slumping; 8 collapsing; 9 almost flat; 10 fully collapsed/inert, no gore. Clear silhouettes and actually different poses. All body anatomy and all appendages consistent. Standing creature longest dimension about 42 logical pixels; expressive lunges remain inside 64x64 logical cell. Draw at consistent enlarged pixel scale, sharp blocks not painted gradients. NO weapons, no motion trail, no glow, no scenery, no ground shadow, no opaque backdrop.

ashuo.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, original character for the Mosslume pixel RPG. Input two sprites are STYLE/PROPORTION references ONLY, not the identity. Match compact 32 logical pixel tall standing body, top-down three-quarter perspective, large head and short body, crisp pixel clusters, tiny face, dark outline, restrained earthy/teal palette. ASHUO, a young adult male camp guard: warm brown skin, short dark brown hair, teal-blue short jacket over cream undershirt, rust red short scarf, brown belt and bracers, dark brown trousers and boots. No helmet, no weapon, no equipment painted into the hands.
Strict atlas layout: EXACTLY ELEVEN equal columns and FOUR equal rows. Total 44 fully isolated sprites, regular grid spacing, completely transparent background with no ground shadow, no grid line, no text. Wide landscape approximately 3:1. Each cell has generous empty padding; feet sit on the SAME baseline, scale NEVER changes. No hair, hand or clothing crosses cell edges. No haze or translucent background.
Rows in order: UP (back toward viewer, no frontal face), RIGHT, DOWN (front), LEFT.
Columns in EACH row: 1 calm neutral standing, arms at sides. 2 walk left foot forward/right back. 3 passing left leg under body. 4 walk right foot forward/left back. 5 passing right leg under body. 6 neutral combat ready hands. 7 initial windup turning chest. 8 maximum windup raised forearm. 9 forward hand strike. 10 follow through. 11 return to neutral ready. All poses keep exact same character identity, head shape, colors, outfit; footwear stays grounded. Actual walking legs visibly alternate. Attack animation empty handed so engine draws held tools separately; no effects, no weapons, no motion trails. Uniform daylight shading baked minimally, no colored scene lighting. Stand silhouette should match reference body-to-head ratio; avoid long thin realistic anatomy or painted smoothing.
